title: The door carries every method kit to every host
summary: `@inventarch/runtime/method` reads method kits (releases format 1 and 2, bundled and IA home kits), selects a repository binding and resolves the method packet in process: the packet and digest the `ia` plugin prints. `ia-mcp-door` adds `ia_session`, `ia_catalogue` and `ia_method`, reads kits from `--kits` or `IA_KITS_DIR` and the IA home, acts at its root or a root the format 2 `workspace-locations.json` registry lists (both earlier formats are read), and restores a kit in process with the language base it now carries. `ia host <claude|codex|copilot> --commit` writes a committable bootstrap: an instruction block naming `ia_session` and the three lanes, and an `ia` MCP server running `npx -y @inventarch/mcp-door@<version>`. The position packet gains the session line. A GitHub Copilot host row is added and Codex hooks are marked supported. Workspace projections render one skill per invocable `@capability`, not one per `@playbook`. `ia host claude --user` installs `ia@inventarch` from `inventarch/marketplace`; `--local` keeps the rendered plugin. `config.json` names `accountOffer` beside `updateCheck`.
